# Shared configuration
-include Make.var

# Demos that run on every andesim mode (fast / cycle / hybrid).
SUBDIRS := demo/hello demo/lm demo/lm_slave demo/lm_dma \
           demo/hvm_slave demo/hvm_dma demo/rvv demo/fp demo/cache \
           demo/verify demo/syscall demo/coremark demo/dhrystone demo/memsize

RUN_TARGETS := $(patsubst demo/%,run-%,$(SUBDIRS))

# RUN_TARGETS are deliberately NOT .PHONY: make never matches pattern
# rules (run-%) against .PHONY targets.
.PHONY: all run check check-all-engines clean $(SUBDIRS)

all: $(SUBDIRS)

$(SUBDIRS):
	$(MAKE) -C $@

run: $(RUN_TARGETS)

run-%:
	$(MAKE) -C demo/$* run

# Forward per-mode targets, e.g. `make hello-fast` -> demo/hello hello-fast.
hello-%:
	$(MAKE) -C demo/hello $@

lm-%:
	$(MAKE) -C demo/lm $@

lm_slave-%:
	$(MAKE) -C demo/lm_slave $@

lm_dma-%:
	$(MAKE) -C demo/lm_dma $@

hvm_slave-%:
	$(MAKE) -C demo/hvm_slave $@

hvm_dma-%:
	$(MAKE) -C demo/hvm_dma $@

rvv-%:
	$(MAKE) -C demo/rvv $@

fp-%:
	$(MAKE) -C demo/fp $@

cache-%:
	$(MAKE) -C demo/cache $@

verify-%:
	$(MAKE) -C demo/verify $@

syscall-%:
	$(MAKE) -C demo/syscall $@

coremark-%:
	$(MAKE) -C demo/coremark $@

dhrystone-%:
	$(MAKE) -C demo/dhrystone $@

memsize-%:
	$(MAKE) -C demo/memsize $@

# Aggregate check: every demo that defines its own `check` runs it (real
# asserts); the rest are asserted to `run` cleanly (exit 0) across all modes.
# Continues past failures and reports a summary. Heavy -- coremark/dhrystone
# run their full cycle/hybrid legs. For one demo use `make check-<name>`.
check:
	@fail=""; \
	for dir in $(SUBDIRS); do \
	  echo "########## $$dir ##########"; \
	  if $(MAKE) -C $$dir -n check >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
	    $(MAKE) -C $$dir check || fail="$$fail $$dir"; \
	  elif $(MAKE) -C $$dir run; then \
	    echo "[PASS] $$dir: run exits 0 (no asserts)"; \
	  else \
	    echo "[FAIL] $$dir: run failed"; fail="$$fail $$dir"; \
	  fi; \
	done; \
	echo "===================================="; \
	if [ -z "$$fail" ]; then echo "ALL DEMOS OK"; \
	else echo "FAILED DEMOS:$$fail"; exit 1; fi

# ---- Engine sweep --------------------------------------------------------
# Demos that need hardware not every engine has. The sweep skips them on an
# engine whose resolved hybrid plan (--dry-run) carries no ILM/DLM/HVM
# sidecar args, or whose `list engines` row shows no VLEN.
NEED_LM  := demo/lm demo/lm_slave demo/lm_dma
NEED_HVM := demo/hvm_slave demo/hvm_dma
NEED_V   := demo/rvv demo/verify

# Run the aggregate `check` once per installed vsim engine -- the engine set
# is parsed from `andesim list engines` at run time (rv64 rows; the demos
# are rv64 builds). Restrict it with SWEEP_ENGINES="vsim:a vsim:b". Fails if
# any engine fails any demo it is capable of.
check-all-engines:
	@engines="$(SWEEP_ENGINES)"; \
	if [ -z "$$engines" ]; then \
	  engines=$$("$(ANDESIM_BIN)" list engines 2>/dev/null \
	             | awk '$$2 == "vsim" && $$4 == 64 { print $$1 }'); \
	fi; \
	if [ -z "$$engines" ]; then \
	  echo "no rv64 vsim engine installed (see: andesim list engines)"; exit 1; \
	fi; \
	$(MAKE) -C demo/hello hello.elf >/dev/null; \
	summary=""; bad=""; \
	for eng in $$engines; do \
	  plan=$$("$(ANDESIM_BIN)" run --mode hybrid --trigger marker \
	          --engine "$$eng" --dry-run demo/hello/hello.elf </dev/null 2>&1); \
	  vlen=$$("$(ANDESIM_BIN)" list engines 2>/dev/null \
	          | awk -v e="$$eng" '$$1 == e { print $$5 }'); \
	  skips=""; \
	  echo "$$plan" | grep -q "ilm_size=[1-9]" || skips="$$skips $(NEED_LM)"; \
	  echo "$$plan" | grep -q "hvm_size=[1-9]" || skips="$$skips $(NEED_HVM)"; \
	  case "$$vlen" in ""|-|0) skips="$$skips $(NEED_V)";; esac; \
	  dirs=""; \
	  for d in $(SUBDIRS); do \
	    case " $$skips " in *" $$d "*) ;; *) dirs="$$dirs $$d";; esac; \
	  done; \
	  echo "#################### ENGINE $$eng ####################"; \
	  if [ -n "$$skips" ]; then echo "[SKIP] $$eng lacks the hardware for:$$skips"; fi; \
	  if $(MAKE) check ENGINE="$$eng" SUBDIRS="$$dirs"; then \
	    summary="$$summary\n  $$eng: OK (skipped:$${skips:- none})"; \
	  else \
	    summary="$$summary\n  $$eng: FAILED"; bad="$$bad $$eng"; \
	  fi; \
	done; \
	echo "#################### ENGINE SWEEP ####################"; \
	printf "engines:$$summary\n"; \
	if [ -n "$$bad" ]; then echo "FAILED ENGINES:$$bad"; exit 1; fi

# Single demo: its own `check` if defined, else assert `run` exits 0.
check-%:
	@if $(MAKE) -C demo/$* -n check >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
	  $(MAKE) -C demo/$* check; \
	else \
	  echo "demo/$*: no asserts -- running to assert exit 0"; \
	  $(MAKE) -C demo/$* run; \
	fi

clean:
	@for dir in $(SUBDIRS); do $(MAKE) -C $$dir clean; done

1	# andesim-demo
2	
3	Demo programs for the `andesim` hybrid RISC-V simulator. One ELF runs on
4	every mode: `fast` (QEMU), `cycle` (vsim, cycle-accurate), and `hybrid`
5	(QEMU fast-forwards the boot, vsim measures your region of interest).
6	
7	## Prerequisites
8	
9	- An `andesim` checkout, already built (`bash scripts/build_all.sh`).
10	  Check it with `./andesim doctor`.
11	- An Andes RISC-V toolchain (the one `doctor` reports).
12	
13	## Step 1: Modify `Make.var`
14	
15	Fill in these settings if your paths differ:
16	
17	```Makefile
18	ANDESIM ?=            # path to the andesim checkout
19	TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX ?=   # e.g. .../bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-
20	ENGINE ?=             # cycle-accurate engine, see `andesim list engines`
21	```
22	
23	## Step 2: Build
24	
25	```bash
26	make
27	```
28	
29	Each demo links against the andesim runtime
30	(`-B $(ANDESIM)/build/runtime -specs=andesim.specs`), so the same binary
31	runs on every mode -- no per-engine builds, no semihosting.
32	
33	## Step 3: Run
34	
35	Run every mode of one demo:
36	
37	```bash
38	make run-hello
39	make run-lm
40	make run-lm_slave
41	make run-lm_dma
42	make run-hvm_slave
43	make run-hvm_dma
44	make run-rvv
45	make run-fp
46	make run-cache
47	make run-verify
48	make run-syscall
49	make run-coremark
50	make run-dhrystone
51	```
52	
53	Or one mode at a time (the `lm-*` / `lm_slave-*` / `lm_dma-*`,
54	`hvm_slave-*` / `hvm_dma-*`, `rvv-*`, `fp-*`, `cache-*`, `verify-*`,
55	`syscall-*`, `coremark-*` and `dhrystone-*` targets work the same way):
56	
57	| Target                     | What it shows                                          |
58	|----------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|

- An `andesim` checkout, already built (`bash scripts/build_all.sh`).

- An Andes RISC-V toolchain (the one `doctor` reports).

Fill in these settings if your paths differ:

```Makefile
ANDESIM ?=            # path to the andesim checkout
TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX ?=   # e.g. .../bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-
```

```bash
make
```

SimControl exit path work; only the HTIF magicmem channel is broken on
this engine. Root cause still open (two theories disproven so far).

commit 29f6dbf: the RTL config always had the memories, but the CPU
wrapper lacked the set_/get_ backdoor pair, so `--describe` advertised
size 0 and the driver armed no sidecars.

Not in this sweep: `vsim:d23` (rv32; the demos are rv64 builds),
`qemu*` (the sweep covers rv64 vsim engines only).
